field: dwmax, maximum soil water capacity, metres
why_this_matters: landmod.f90 computes runoff as the overflow of this bucket, so a uniform default makes runoff a namelist property rather than a soil property. The 0.96 climatology's 2.8% land runoff ratio against Earth's ~35% is the symptom.
not_enabled_by_default: Requires model.soil_water_source: pedology in config/planet.yaml. That key is absent on purpose: adding it is a configuration change continue_exoplasim.py refuses to resume across, so it blocks resumption of runs in flight.
